release_read.basis: Q3 beat its own guide on subs (306M vs 305M), gross margin (33.0% vs 32.9%) and operating income (EUR 672M vs 670M, despite EUR 13M extra social charges); the Q4 guide is the line the stock trades on and it reads strong: GM 33.8% and operating income EUR 820M with +10M subs, which does not show the audiobook/Rogan margin squeeze the short thesis needed. Street consensus for the Q4 guide was not found, so sized well inside the 8.3% implied move.

key_line.detail: Q4 guide: operating income EUR 820M, gross margin 33.8%, revenue EUR 5.2B, MAU 818M, subs 316M. Street consensus for the Q4 guide not found in the time available.

guidance.detail: Next-quarter guide issued (OI EUR 820M, GM 33.8%); cannot be labelled raised/lowered against the street without a consensus figure. Against the thesis (margin squeeze from audiobooks/Rogan) it reads strong, and the pre-market treats it as a clear beat.

call.detail: Live Q&A scheduled 08:00 ET per the release, so it is over before the open; its content was not reviewed in the time available. No call risk during the session.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched: time budget spent on the release and the tape.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 564.98 = +7.55% vs prev close 525.34, near the 8.28% implied move and well above the +3.0% release read; against a market down ~0.9% (SPY). Pre-market active: 183 prints, 26 in the last 30 min, last at 09:16, not stale. Range 510.00-568.68; the low is likely an early stray print. Short is -8.37% vs entry 520.85.

thesis_check.note: The short thesis was a Q4 margin/EBIT guide hit from audiobook and Rogan costs; the guide shows GM up 80bp q/q to 33.8% and OI EUR 820M, and Q3 beat on subs, GM and OI.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market in a liquid large cap (183 prints, last at 09:16) so the open should hold nearly all of the +7.5%; a gap that size, close to the full implied move and above the release read, in a weak tape (SPY -0.9%), tends to give back part by 10:00, while the bmo prior and a clean beat argue against a deep fade.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers en vooral de Q4-vooruitblik (hogere marge, EUR 820 mln bedrijfswinst) gaan tegen de short in, en het aandeel staat voorbeurs ongeveer 7,5% hoger, dicht bij de volle verwachte beweging en meer dan de cijfers volgens ons rechtvaardigen. Een sprong van die omvang zakt vaak deels terug in het eerste half uur, en de toelichting is al voorbij, dus dek de short om 10:00 in plaats van bij de opening of pas om 13:00.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 verder oploopt richting 570 of hoger met veel handel, dan doorbreekt hij de verwachte beweging en is direct dekken bij de opening beter.
